Pladehæmmere (antiplatelet agents) are mentioned once in the corpus as a pharmaceutical risk factor in the context of atrial fibrillation treatment [^src1]. According to the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database annual report covering July 2022 to June 2023, avoiding the use of pladehæmmere, alongside NSAIDs, is highlighted as a critical clinical measure to reduce the incidence of intracranial hemorrhages in this patient population [^src1]. No further details, relationships, or timeline events regarding this entity are available in the provided text.

## Mentions
- Page 66: "Desuden vil den øgede opmærksomhed på ikke at anvende pladehæmmere og NSAID samt bedre kontrol af blodtryk og reduktion af befolkningens alkoholforbrug lede til færre intrakranielle blødninger." [^src1]
